name: Asset issuers
description: Entities creating and originating tokenized assets, including public and private market offerings.
including: Public Assets, Private Assets, Derivatives, Crypto Assets, Other Issuers

name: Asset managers and fund managers
description: Managers of investment funds and portfolios aiming to deliver returns for institutional and retail clients.
including: Asset managers, Hedge funds, Mutual funds and ETF operators, Pension and  Insurance Companies, Private Market Funds

name: Clearing & Settlement
description: Providers ensuring accurate post-trade matching, netting, and settlement finality.
including: Clearing and settlement houses, Settlement Agents

name: Collateral management services
description: Collateral services that support trading, settlement, and financing by sourcing, pledging, monitoring, and reallocating assets in traditional and digital markets.
including: Collateral Managers, Digital Collateral Providers, Collateral Optimization Services

name: CSDs TAs & Registry Services
description: CSDs, TAs, and other entities that maintain securities and token registries and provide asset servicing.
including: Central Securities Depositories (CSDs), Transfer Agents, Token Registrars, Asset Servicing

name: Direct investors
description: Capital providers purchasing and holding tokenized assets directly, including both institutional and individual participants.
including: Individual Investors, Institutional investors, Sovereign Wealth Funds & Endowments & Foundations, Corporate &  Strategic Investors

name: Institutional trading desks
description: Active market participants executing trades and managing positions for profit or risk management.
including: Trading desks, Treasury desks, Investment banks, Prime Brokers, Market Makers, Other Trading Firms

name: Investor custody and wallet services
description: Institutions safeguarding investor holdings and providing wallet infrastructure.
including: Custodians, Digital Asset Custody Platforms, Wallet Technology Providers

name: Market data & analytics services
description: Entities delivering market intelligence, credit ratings, and analytical insights for participants.
including: Data providers, Rating and Analytics Firms

name: Payments and cash management providers
description: Services handling monetary flows, collateral movements, and payment settlements.
including: Payment Providers, Commercial banks - cash & payments, Stablecoin Issuers, Digital Cash Providers, On/Off-Ramp Providers

name: Technology providers
description: Technology and connectivity providers enabling trading, settlement, custody, and asset lifecycle operations.
including: Application developers and Financial Technology companies, FIX developers and service providers, DeFi platforms, Regulatory Service Providers, Blockchain and Smart Contract Developers and Auditors

name: Trading venues and distribution channels
description: Venues and systems enabling trading, issuance, and distribution of assets.
including: Broker dealers, ATSs, Exchanges, Crypto Exchanges, Trading Platforms, Order Management Systems, Tokenization Platforms

name: Wealth managers and advisors
description: Firms and professionals providing investment, financial planning, and advisory services to individuals, families, and smaller institutions.
including: Wealth Management, Private banks, Retail banks, RIAs, Financial advisors, Family Offices
